        "originalContents": "# Unified Pipeline Interface Implementation Plan\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document outlines the implementation strategy for creating a unified user interface that integrates all existing processing pipelines (agent-execution, document-processing, and web-processing) while maintaining backward compatibility with the existing separate implementations.\n\n## Architecture Goals\n\n1. **Unified Experience**: Create a single, cohesive UI for all AI pipeline operations\n2. **Shared Context**: Leverage a common context for state and business logic\n3. **Backward Compatibility**: Maintain existing pipeline files and interfaces\n4. **Performance Optimization**: Minimize redundant renders and API calls\n5. **Extensible Design**: Allow for easy addition of future pipelines\n\n## Implementation Components\n\n### 1. Shared Context Provider\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// src/features/ai/pipelines/unified/UnifiedPipelineContext.tsx\n\nimport { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, ReactNode } from 'react'\nimport { useAssistantRuntime } from '@assistant-ui/react'\nimport { \n  // Import utilities, types and logic from existing pipelines\n  type DocumentProcessingState,\n  type WebProcessingState,\n  type AgentExecutionState\n} from '../types'\n\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# AIPipeline Implementation Documentation\n\n## Key Modules\n\n- **UnifiedPipelineContext**: Centralized context provider for all pipeline state and actions.\n- **Adapter Utilities**: Functions to map between unified and legacy pipeline state formats.\n- **Business Logic Integration**: Imports and re-exports helpers from legacy pipelines; adds cross-pipeline logic.\n- **Adapter Components**: Bridge unified context to legacy pipeline UI components.\n- **Unified View**: Combines quick input and results from all pipelines.\n- **AIPipeline**: Main UI component with tabbed interface.\n\n## Process \u0026 Component Architecture\n\n### Data Flow\n\n1. **UnifiedPipelineProvider** manages all state and business logic.\n2. **Adapter Components** use the context and map state/actions to props for legacy UI.\n3. **Unified View** and tabbed interface allow switching between unified and individual pipeline UIs.\n4. **Business Logic** is called from context functions, ensuring single source of truth.\n5. **AI Assistant Integration** uses context registration for model context.\n\n### Component Structure\n\n- &#96;AIPipeline.tsx&#96; (main export)\n  - &#96;UnifiedPipelineProvider&#96;\n    - &#96;UnifiedPipelineInterfaceContent&#96;\n      - &#96;Tabs&#96; (unified, document, web, agent)\n        - &#96;UnifiedView&#96; (unified tab)\n        - &#96;DocumentProcessingAdapter&#96; (document tab)\n        - &#96;WebProcessingAdapter&#96; (web tab)\n        - &#96;AgentExecutionAdapter&#96; (agent tab)\n\n### Extensibility\n\n- To add a new pipeline:\n  - Add state and actions to context\n  - Create adapter utility and component\n  - Add new tab in UI\n\n### Performance\n\n- Use memoization for expensive calculations\n- Use dynamic imports for pipeline-specific components\n- Only update affected components on state change\n\n### Error Handling\n\n- All context functions should handle errors and update state accordingly\n- UI should display error messages where appropriate\n\n### Testing\n\n- Unit tests for context, adapters, and UI components (not included here)\n\n## Usage\n\nImport and use &#96;\u003cAIPipeline /\u003e&#96; in your page/component. The provider and all logic are encapsulated.\n\n---\n\nSee &#96;AIPipeline_PSEUDOCODE.md&#96; for detailed pseudocode and implementation plan.\n",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "# AIPipeline Implementation Documentation"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "## Key Modules"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "- **UnifiedPipelineContext**: Centralized context provider for all pipeline state and actions."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,

        "originalContents": "# AIPipeline Implementation Documentation\n\n## Key Modules\n\n- **UnifiedPipelineContext**: Centralized context provider for all pipeline state and actions.\n- **Adapter Utilities**: Functions to map between unified and legacy pipeline state formats.\n- **Business Logic Integration**: Imports and re-exports helpers from legacy pipelines; adds cross-pipeline logic.\n- **Adapter Components**: Bridge unified context to legacy pipeline UI components.\n- **Unified View**: Combines quick input and results from all pipelines.\n- **AIPipeline**: Main UI component with tabbed interface.\n\n## Process \u0026 Component Architecture\n\n### Data Flow\n\n1. **UnifiedPipelineProvider** manages all state and business logic.\n2. **Adapter Components** use the context and map state/actions to props for legacy UI.\n3. **Unified View** and tabbed interface allow switching between unified and individual pipeline UIs.\n4. **Business Logic** is called from context functions, ensuring single source of truth.\n5. **AI Assistant Integration** uses context registration for model context.\n\n### Component Structure\n\n- &#96;AIPipeline.tsx&#96; (main export)\n  - &#96;UnifiedPipelineProvider&#96;\n    - &#96;UnifiedPipelineInterfaceContent&#96;\n      - &#96;Tabs&#96; (unified, document, web, agent)\n        - &#96;UnifiedView&#96; (unified tab)\n        - &#96;DocumentProcessingAdapter&#96; (document tab)\n        - &#96;WebProcessingAdapter&#96; (web tab)\n        - &#96;AgentExecutionAdapter&#96; (agent tab)\n\n### Extensibility\n\n- To add a new pipeline:\n  - Add state and actions to context\n  - Create adapter utility and component\n  - Add new tab in UI\n\n### Performance\n\n- Use memoization for expensive calculations\n- Use dynamic imports for pipeline-specific components\n- Only update affected components on state change\n\n### Error Handling\n\n- All context functions should handle errors and update state accordingly\n- UI should display error messages where appropriate\n\n### Testing\n\n- Unit tests for context, adapters, and UI components (not included here)\n\n## Usage\n\nImport and use &#96;\u003cAIPipeline /\u003e&#96; in your page/component. The provider and all logic are encapsulated.\n\n---\n\nSee &#96;AIPipeline_PSEUDOCODE.md&#96; for detailed pseudocode and implementation plan.\n",

Context Provider (UnifiedPipelineContext)\n\n- Define types for unified state: DocumentProcessingState, WebProcessingState, AgentExecutionState\n- Create UnifiedPipelineContext with:\n  - activeTab: 'document' | 'web' | 'agent' | 'unified'\n  - setActiveTab(tab)\n  - isProcessing\n  - documentState, uploadDocument(file), analyzeDocument(documentId)\n  - webState, processWebUrl(url), summarizeWebContent(content)\n  - agentState, executeAgent(prompt, context?)\n  - combineResults(), exportResults(format)\n  - addToAIContext(data)\n- Implement UnifiedPipelineProvider:\n  - useState for all state\n  - useAssistantRuntime for AI context\n  - Implement all functions, calling legacy pipeline logic\n  - Register model context with assistantRuntime\n  - Provide context value\n- Export useUnifiedPipeline hook\n\n## 2. Adapter Utilities\n\n- mapDocumentStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapWebStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapAgentStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapDocumentStateToUnified(originalState)\n- mapWebStateToUnified(originalState)\n- mapAgentStateToUnified(originalState)\n\n## 3.         "originalContents": "# AIPipeline Implementation Pseudocode\n\n## 1. Context Provider (UnifiedPipelineContext)\n\n- Define types for unified state: DocumentProcessingState, WebProcessingState, AgentExecutionState\n- Create UnifiedPipelineContext with:\n  - activeTab: 'document' | 'web' | 'agent' | 'unified'\n  - setActiveTab(tab)\n  - isProcessing\n  - documentState, uploadDocument(file), analyzeDocument(documentId)\n  - webState, processWebUrl(url), summarizeWebContent(content)\n  - agentState, executeAgent(prompt, context?)\n  - combineResults(), exportResults(format)\n  - addToAIContext(data)\n- Implement UnifiedPipelineProvider:\n  - useState for all state\n  - useAssistantRuntime for AI context\n  - Implement all functions, calling legacy pipeline logic\n  - Register model context with assistantRuntime\n  - Provide context value\n- Export useUnifiedPipeline hook\n\n## 2. Adapter Utilities\n\n- mapDocumentStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapWebStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapAgentStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapDocumentStateToUnified(originalState)\n- mapWebStateToUnified(originalState)\n- mapAgentStateToUnified(originalState)\n\n## 3. Business Logic Integration\n\n- Import and re-export helpers from legacy pipelines:\n  - analyzeDocument, vectorizeDocument\n  - scrapeAndSummarize\n  - executeAgentWorkflow\n- Implement combinePipelineResults(documentResults, webResults, agentResults)\n- Implement createCrossContextualSummary(documentResults, webResults, agentResults)\n\n## 4. Adapter Components\n\n- DocumentProcessingAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy DocumentProcessingPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n- WebProcessingAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy WebProcessingPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n- AgentExecutionAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy AgentExecutionPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n\n## 5. Unified View\n\n- useUnifiedPipeline\n- Render quick input sections for each pipeline\n- Render combined results section\n- Render AI Assistant integration section\n\n## 6. Main UI Component (AIPipeline)\n\n- UnifiedPipelineProvider wraps UnifiedPipelineInterfaceContent\n",

        "contents": "\n\nexport function DocumentStatus({\n  document: initialDocument,\n  tasks: initialTasks,\n  onUpdate,\n  className,\n}: DocumentStatusProps) {\n  const [document, setDocument] = useState(initialDocument)\n  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState(initialTasks)\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    let timeoutId: NodeJS.Timeout\n    const POLL_INTERVAL = 5000 // 5 seconds\n\n    const pollStatus = async () =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const result = await getDocumentStatus(document.id)\n\n        if (!result.success) {\n          throw new Error(result.error)\n        }\n\n        setDocument(result.document)\n        setTasks(result.tasks)\n        onUpdate?.(result.document, result.tasks)\n\n        // Continue polling if document is still processing\n        if (result.document.status === 'processing') {\n          timeoutId = setTimeout(pollStatus, POLL_INTERVAL)\n        }\n      } catch (err) {\n        setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to fetch status')\n        console.error('Error polling status:', err)\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Only start polling if the document is in processing state\n    if (document.status === 'processing') {\n      timeoutId = setTimeout(pollStatus, POLL_INTERVAL)\n    }\n\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId)\n    }\n  }, [document.id, document.status, onUpdate])\n\n  const getDocumentProgress = () =\u003e {\n    if (tasks.length === 0) return 0\n    const completedTasks = tasks.filter((task) =\u003e task.status === 'processed').length\n    return Math.round((completedTasks / tasks.length) * 100)\n  }\n\n  const getLatestTask = () =\u003e {\n    return tasks.sort(\n      (a, b) =\u003e new Date(b.created_at).getTime() - new Date(a.created_at).getTime()\n    )[0]\n  }\n\n  const progress = getDocumentProgress()\n  const latestTask = getLatestTask()\n  const isProcessing = document.status === 'processing'\n  const isError = document.status === 'error' || error",

        "originalContents": "'use client'\n\nimport React, {useState} from 'react'\nimport {useUnifiedPipeline} from '../unified/AIPipeline'\n\nexport function WebProcessingPipeline() {\n  const {addWebData, setIsProcessing, isProcessing} = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  const [url, setUrl] = useState('')\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('')\n  const [analysisResults, setAnalysisResults] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('')\n  const [searchOption, setSearchOption] = useState\u003c'url' | 'search'\u003e('url')\n\n  const processWebContent = async () =\u003e {\n    if (searchOption === 'url' \u0026\u0026 !url) {\n      alert('Please enter a URL')\n      return\n    }\n\n    if (searchOption === 'search' \u0026\u0026 !searchQuery) {\n      alert('Please enter a search query')\n      return\n    }\n\n    setIsProcessing(true)\n\n    try {\n      // Simulate web processing with a delay\n      // In a real implementation, this would call a web scraping/search service\n      await new Promise((resolve) =\u003e setTimeout(resolve, 2000))\n\n      // Sample analysis results\n      const analysis =\n        searchOption === 'url'\n          ? {\n              title: &#96;Page Title for ${url}&#96;,\n              summary: 'This is a sample summary of the web page content.',\n              mainTopics: ['Topic 1', 'Topic 2', 'Topic 3'],\n              entities: ['Entity 1', 'Entity 2', 'Entity 3'],\n              sentiment: Math.random() \u003e 0.5 ? 'positive' : 'negative',\n            }\n          : {\n              searchResults: [\n                {title: 'Result 1', snippet: 'Snippet from result 1', url: 'https://example.com/1'},\n                {title: 'Result 2', snippet: 'Snippet from result 2', url: 'https://example.com/2'},\n                {title: 'Result 3', snippet: 'Snippet from result 3', url: 'https://example.com/3'},\n              ],\n              relatedQueries: ['Related query 1', 'Related query 2', 'Related query 3'],\n              topSources: ['Source 1', 'Source 2', 'Source 3'],\n            }\n\n      // Format analysis for display\n      const formattedAnalysis = JSON.stringify(analysis, null, 2)",

        "contents": "function DocumentProcessingAdapter(props: any) {\n  const { documentState, uploadDocument, analyzeDocument } = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  \n  // Map unified context to props expected by original component\n  const adaptedProps = {\n    ...props,\n    documents: documentState.documents,\n    onUpload: uploadDocument,\n    onAnalyze: analyzeDocument\n    // Add other props mappings as needed\n  }\n  \n  // Render UI similar to original component but using unified context\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"document-processing\"\u003e\n      {/* Document UI components using adaptedProps */}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\nfunction WebProcessingAdapter(props: any) {\n  const { webState, processWebUrl } = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  \n  // Map unified context to props expected by original component\n  const adaptedProps = {\n    ...props,\n    url: webState.url,\n    content: webState.content,\n    onProcess: processWebUrl\n    // Add other props mappings as needed\n  }\n  \n  // Render UI similar to original component but using unified context\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"web-processing\"\u003e\n      {/* Web UI components using adaptedProps */}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\nfunction AgentExecutionAdapter(props: any) {\n  const { agentState, executeAgent } = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  \n  // Map unified context to props expected by original component\n  const adaptedProps = {\n    ...props,\n    agents: agentState.agents,\n    onExecute: executeAgent\n    // Add other props mappings as needed\n  }\n  \n  // Render UI similar to original component but using unified context\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"agent-execution\"\u003e\n      {/* Agent UI components using adaptedProps */}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\n// Unified view that combines elements from all pipelines\n",

        "contents": "# Unified Pipeline Interface Implementation Plan\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document outlines the implementation strategy for creating a unified user interface that integrates all existing processing pipelines (agent-execution, document-processing, and web-processing) while maintaining backward compatibility with the existing separate implementations.\n\n## Architecture Goals\n\n1. **Unified Experience**: Create a single, cohesive UI for all AI pipeline operations\n2. **Shared Context**: Leverage a common context for state and business logic\n3. **Backward Compatibility**: Maintain existing pipeline files and interfaces\n4. **Performance Optimization**: Minimize redundant renders and API calls\n5. **Extensible Design**: Allow for easy addition of future pipelines\n\n## Implementation Components\n\n### 1. Shared Context Provider\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// src/features/ai/pipelines/unified/UnifiedPipelineContext.tsx\n\nimport { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, ReactNode } from 'react'\nimport { useAssistantRuntime } from '@assistant-ui/react'\nimport { \n  // Import utilities, types and logic from existing pipelines\n  type DocumentProcessingState,\n  type WebProcessingState,\n  type AgentExecutionState\n} from '../types'\n\n",

        "originalContents": "# Unified Pipeline Interface Implementation Plan\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document outlines the implementation strategy for creating a unified user interface that integrates all existing processing pipelines (agent-execution, document-processing, and web-processing) while maintaining backward compatibility with the existing separate implementations.\n\n## Architecture Goals\n\n1. **Unified Experience**: Create a single, cohesive UI for all AI pipeline operations\n2. **Shared Context**: Leverage a common context for state and business logic\n3. **Backward Compatibility**: Maintain existing pipeline files and interfaces\n4. **Performance Optimization**: Minimize redundant renders and API calls\n5. **Extensible Design**: Allow for easy addition of future pipelines\n\n## Implementation Components\n\n### 1.         "contents": "'use client'\n\nimport type React from 'react'\nimport {useState, useRef} from 'react'\nimport {useUnifiedPipeline} from '../unified/AIPipeline'\n\nexport function VideoProcessingPipeline() {\n  const {addVideoData, setIsProcessing, isProcessing} = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  const [videoFile, setVideoFile] = useState\u003cFile | null\u003e(null)\n  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('')\n  const [analysis, setAnalysis] = useState\u003cany\u003e(null)\n  const [currentFrame, setCurrentFrame] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n  const [processingStage, setProcessingStage] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('')\n  const videoRef = useRef\u003cHTMLVideoElement\u003e(null)\n\n  const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent\u003cHTMLInputElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    const file = e.target.files?.[0]\n    if (file) {\n      setVideoFile(file)\n      // Create URL for video preview\n      const url = URL.createObjectURL(file)\n      setVideoUrl(url)\n      // Reset states\n      setAnalysis(null)\n      setCurrentFrame(null)\n    }\n  }\n\n  const captureFrame = () =\u003e {\n    if (videoRef.current) {\n      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')\n      canvas.width = videoRef.current.videoWidth\n      canvas.height = videoRef.current.videoHeight\n      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')\n      if (ctx) {\n        ctx.drawImage(videoRef.current, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)\n        const frameUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg')\n        setCurrentFrame(frameUrl)\n        return frameUrl\n      }\n    }\n    return null\n  }",

        "contents": "# AIPipeline Implementation Pseudocode\n\n## 1. Context Provider (UnifiedPipelineContext)\n\n- Define types for unified state: DocumentProcessingState, WebProcessingState, AgentExecutionState\n- Create UnifiedPipelineContext with:\n  - activeTab: 'document' | 'web' | 'agent' | 'unified'\n  - setActiveTab(tab)\n  - isProcessing\n  - documentState, uploadDocument(file), analyzeDocument(documentId)\n  - webState, processWebUrl(url), summarizeWebContent(content)\n  - agentState, executeAgent(prompt, context?)\n  - combineResults(), exportResults(format)\n  - addToAIContext(data)\n- Implement UnifiedPipelineProvider:\n  - useState for all state\n  - useAssistantRuntime for AI context\n  - Implement all functions, calling legacy pipeline logic\n  - Register model context with assistantRuntime\n  - Provide context value\n- Export useUnifiedPipeline hook\n\n## 2. Adapter Utilities\n\n- mapDocumentStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapWebStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapAgentStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapDocumentStateToUnified(originalState)\n- mapWebStateToUnified(originalState)\n- mapAgentStateToUnified(originalState)\n\n## 3. Business Logic Integration\n\n- Import and re-export helpers from legacy pipelines:\n  - analyzeDocument, vectorizeDocument\n  - scrapeAndSummarize\n  - executeAgentWorkflow\n- Implement combinePipelineResults(documentResults, webResults, agentResults)\n- Implement createCrossContextualSummary(documentResults, webResults, agentResults)\n\n## 4. Adapter Components\n\n- DocumentProcessingAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy DocumentProcessingPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n- WebProcessingAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy WebProcessingPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n- AgentExecutionAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy AgentExecutionPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n\n## 5. Unified View\n\n- useUnifiedPipeline\n- Render quick input sections for each pipeline\n- Render combined results section\n- Render AI Assistant integration section\n\n## 6. Main UI Component (AIPipeline)\n\n- UnifiedPipelineProvider wraps UnifiedPipelineInterfaceContent\n",

        "originalContents": "# AIPipeline Implementation Pseudocode\n\n## 1. Context Provider (UnifiedPipelineContext)\n\n- Define types for unified state: DocumentProcessingState, WebProcessingState, AgentExecutionState\n- Create UnifiedPipelineContext with:\n  - activeTab: 'document' | 'web' | 'agent' | 'unified'\n  - setActiveTab(tab)\n  - isProcessing\n  - documentState, uploadDocument(file), analyzeDocument(documentId)\n  - webState, processWebUrl(url), summarizeWebContent(content)\n  - agentState, executeAgent(prompt, context?)\n  - combineResults(), exportResults(format)\n  - addToAIContext(data)\n- Implement UnifiedPipelineProvider:\n  - useState for all state\n  - useAssistantRuntime for AI context\n  - Implement all functions, calling legacy pipeline logic\n  - Register model context with assistantRuntime\n  - Provide context value\n- Export useUnifiedPipeline hook\n\n## 2. Business Logic Integration\n\n- Import and re-export helpers from legacy pipelines:\n  - analyzeDocument, vectorizeDocument\n  - scrapeAndSummarize\n  - executeAgentWorkflow\n- Implement combinePipelineResults(documentResults, webResults, agentResults)\n- Implement createCrossContextualSummary(documentResults, webResults, agentResults)\n\n## 4. Adapter Components\n\n- DocumentProcessingAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy DocumentProcessingPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n- WebProcessingAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy WebProcessingPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n- AgentExecutionAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy AgentExecutionPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n\n## 5.         "contents": "# AIPipeline Implementation Pseudocode\n\n## 1. Context Provider (UnifiedPipelineContext)\n\n- Define types for unified state: DocumentProcessingState, WebProcessingState, AgentExecutionState\n- Create UnifiedPipelineContext with:\n  - activeTab: 'document' | 'web' | 'agent' | 'unified'\n  - setActiveTab(tab)\n  - isProcessing\n  - documentState, uploadDocument(file), analyzeDocument(documentId)\n  - webState, processWebUrl(url), summarizeWebContent(content)\n  - agentState, executeAgent(prompt, context?)\n  - combineResults(), exportResults(format)\n  - addToAIContext(data)\n- Implement UnifiedPipelineProvider:\n  - useState for all state\n  - useAssistantRuntime for AI context\n  - Implement all functions, calling legacy pipeline logic\n  - Register model context with assistantRuntime\n  - Provide context value\n- Export useUnifiedPipeline hook\n\n## 2.         "contents": "function DocumentProcessingAdapter(props: any) {\n  const { documentState, uploadDocument, analyzeDocument } = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  \n  // Map unified context to props expected by original component\n  const adaptedProps = {\n    ...props,\n    documents: documentState.documents,\n    onUpload: uploadDocument,\n    onAnalyze: analyzeDocument\n    // Add other props mappings as needed\n  }\n  \n  // Render UI similar to original component but using unified context\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"document-processing\"\u003e\n      {/* Document UI components using adaptedProps */}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\nfunction WebProcessingAdapter(props: any) {\n  const { webState, processWebUrl } = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  \n  // Map unified context to props expected by original component\n  const adaptedProps = {\n    ...props,\n    url: webState.url,\n    content: webState.content,\n    onProcess: processWebUrl\n    // Add other props mappings as needed\n  }\n  \n  // Render UI similar to original component but using unified context\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"web-processing\"\u003e\n      {/* Web UI components using adaptedProps */}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\nfunction AgentExecutionAdapter(props: any) {\n  const { agentState, executeAgent } = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  \n  // Map unified context to props expected by original component\n  const adaptedProps = {\n    ...props,\n    agents: agentState.agents,\n    onExecute: executeAgent\n    // Add other props mappings as needed\n  }\n  \n  // Render UI similar to original component but using unified context\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"agent-execution\"\u003e\n      {/* Agent UI components using adaptedProps */}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\n// Unified view that combines elements from all pipelines\n",

Document Processing\n          ${JSON.stringify(documentState, null, 2)}\n          \n          ## Web Processing\n          ${JSON.stringify(webState, null, 2)}\n          \n          ## Agent Execution\n          ${JSON.stringify(agentState, null, 2)}\n        &#96;\n      })\n    })\n    \n    return unregister\n  }, [assistantRuntime, activeTab, documentState, webState, agentState])\n  \n  // Create context value\n",

        "contents": "# AIPipeline Implementation Documentation\n\n## Key Modules\n\n- **UnifiedPipelineContext**: Centralized context provider for all pipeline state and actions.\n- **Adapter Utilities**: Functions to map between unified and legacy pipeline state formats.\n- **Business Logic Integration**: Imports and re-exports helpers from legacy pipelines; adds cross-pipeline logic.\n- **Adapter Components**: Bridge unified context to legacy pipeline UI components.\n- **Unified View**: Combines quick input and results from all pipelines.\n- **AIPipeline**: Main UI component with tabbed interface.\n\n## Process \u0026 Component Architecture\n\n### Data Flow\n\n1. **UnifiedPipelineProvider** manages all state and business logic.\n2. **Adapter Components** use the context and map state/actions to props for legacy UI.\n3. **Unified View** and tabbed interface allow switching between unified and individual pipeline UIs.\n4. **Business Logic** is called from context functions, ensuring single source of truth.\n5. **AI Assistant Integration** uses context registration for model context.\n\n### Component Structure\n\n- &#96;AIPipeline.tsx&#96; (main export)\n  - &#96;UnifiedPipelineProvider&#96;\n    - &#96;UnifiedPipelineInterfaceContent&#96;\n      - &#96;Tabs&#96; (unified, document, web, agent)\n        - &#96;UnifiedView&#96; (unified tab)\n        - &#96;DocumentProcessingAdapter&#96; (document tab)\n        - &#96;WebProcessingAdapter&#96; (web tab)\n        - &#96;AgentExecutionAdapter&#96; (agent tab)\n\n### Extensibility\n\n- To add a new pipeline:\n  - Add state and actions to context\n  - Create adapter utility and component\n  - Add new tab in UI\n\n### Performance\n\n- Use memoization for expensive calculations\n- Use dynamic imports for pipeline-specific components\n- Only update affected components on state change\n\n### Error Handling\n\n- All context functions should handle errors and update state accordingly\n- UI should display error messages where appropriate\n\n### Testing\n\n- Unit tests for context, adapters, and UI components (not included here)\n\n## Usage\n\nImport and use &#96;\u003cAIPipeline /\u003e&#96; in your page/component. The provider and all logic are encapsulated.\n\n---\n\nSee &#96;AIPipeline_PSEUDOCODE.md&#96; for detailed pseudocode and implementation plan.\n",

        "contents": "# Unified Pipeline Interface Implementation Plan\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document outlines the implementation strategy for creating a unified user interface that integrates all existing processing pipelines (agent-execution, document-processing, and web-processing) while maintaining backward compatibility with the existing separate implementations.\n\n## Architecture Goals\n\n1. **Unified Experience**: Create a single, cohesive UI for all AI pipeline operations\n2. **Shared Context**: Leverage a common context for state and business logic\n3. **Backward Compatibility**: Maintain existing pipeline files and interfaces\n4. **Performance Optimization**: Minimize redundant renders and API calls\n5. **Extensible Design**: Allow for easy addition of future pipelines\n\n## Implementation Components\n\n### 1.         "originalContents": "# Unified Pipeline Interface Implementation Plan\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document outlines the implementation strategy for creating a unified user interface that integrates all existing processing pipelines (agent-execution, document-processing, and web-processing) while maintaining backward compatibility with the existing separate implementations.\n\n## Architecture Goals\n\n1. **Unified Experience**: Create a single, cohesive UI for all AI pipeline operations\n2. **Shared Context**: Leverage a common context for state and business logic\n3. **Backward Compatibility**: Maintain existing pipeline files and interfaces\n4. **Performance Optimization**: Minimize redundant renders and API calls\n5. **Extensible Design**: Allow for easy addition of future pipelines\n\n## Implementation Components\n\n### 1.       "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export function UnifiedPipelineProvider({children}: {children: ReactNode}) {\n...\nexport function UnifiedPipelineProvider({children}: {children: ReactNode}) {\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003cPipelineTab\u003e('unified')\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Generate insights by combining data from all pipelines\n  const generateCompositeInsights = async () =\u003e {\n    setIsProcessing(true)\n\n    try {\n      // In a real implementation, this would call an AI service to generate insights\n      // For now, we'll just create a simple synthesis\n      const documentSummaries = compositeData.documents.map((d) =\u003e d.title).join(', ')\n      const webSummaries = compositeData.webResources.map((w) =\u003e w.title || w.url).join(', ')\n      const agentSummaries = compositeData.agentResults.map((a) =\u003e a.prompt).join(', ')\n\n      const combinedInsights = &#96;\n        # Composite Analysis\n        \n        ## Document Insights\n        Found ${compositeData.documents.length} documents: ${documentSummaries}\n        \n        ## Web Resources\n        Analyzed ${compositeData.webResources.length} web resources: ${webSummaries}\n        \n        ## Agent Processing\n        Executed ${compositeData.agentResults.length} agent workflows: ${agentSummaries}\n        \n        ## Overall Insights\n        This analysis combines structured document data with web information and agent-based processing\n        to create a comprehensive understanding of the subject matter.\n      &#96;\n\n      setCompositeData((prev) =\u003e ({\n        ...prev,\n        combinedInsights,\n      }))\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error generating composite insights:', error)\n    } finally {\n      setIsProcessing(false)\n    }\n  }",

+\n          &#96;Web Resources,${compositeData.webResources.length}\\n&#96; +\n          &#96;Agent Results,${compositeData.agentResults.length}&#96;\n        break\n      default:\n        exportData = JSON.stringify(compositeData)\n    }\n\n    // In a real implementation, this would trigger a download\n    // For now, we'll just log it\n    console.log(&#96;Exporting in ${format} format:&#96;, exportData)\n  }\n\n  // Register with Assistant UI for context awareness\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const unregister = assistantRuntime.registerModelContextProvider({\n      getModelContext: () =\u003e ({\n        system: &#96;# Unified Pipeline Context\nActive pipeline: ${activeTab}\n\n## Composite Knowledge Layer\n${JSON.stringify(compositeData, null, 2)}\n&#96;,\n      }),\n    })\n    return unregister\n  }, [assistantRuntime, activeTab, compositeData])\n\n  // Create context value with all shared functions\n  const contextValue = useMemo(\n    () =\u003e ({\n      activeTab,\n      setActiveTab,\n      isProcessing,\n      setIsProcessing,\n      compositeData,\n      addDocumentData,\n      addWebData,\n      addAgentData,\n      generateCompositeInsights,\n      exportCompositeData,\n    }),\n    [activeTab, isProcessing, compositeData]\n  )\n\n  return (\n    \u003cUnifiedPipelineContext.Provider value={contextValue}\u003e\n      {children}\n    \u003c/UnifiedPipelineContext.Provider\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Export composite data in various formats\n  const exportCompositeData = (format: 'json' | 'markdown' | 'csv') =\u003e {\n    let exportData: string\n\n    switch (format) {\n      case 'json':\n        exportData = JSON.stringify(compositeData, null, 2)\n        break\n      case 'markdown':\n        exportData =\n          compositeData.combinedInsights ||\n          &#96;# Composite Data\\n\\n${JSON.stringify(compositeData, null, 2)}&#96;\n        break\n      case 'csv':\n        // Simplified CSV export - would need proper implementation\n        exportData =\n          'Data Type,Count\\n' +\n          &#96;Documents,${compositeData.documents.length}\\n&#96; +\n          &#96;Web Resources,${compositeData.webResources.length}\\n&#96; +\n          &#96;Agent Results,${compositeData.agentResults.length}&#96;\n        break\n      default:\n        exportData = JSON.stringify(compositeData)\n    }\n\n    // In a real implementation, this would trigger a download\n    // For now, we'll just log it\n    console.log(&#96;Exporting in ${format} format:&#96;, exportData)\n  }\n\n  // Register with Assistant UI for context awareness\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const unregister = assistantRuntime.registerModelContextProvider({\n      getModelContext: () =\u003e ({\n        system: &#96;# Unified Pipeline Context\nActive pipeline: ${activeTab}\n\n## Composite Knowledge Layer\n${JSON.stringify(compositeData, null, 2)}\n&#96;,\n      }),\n    })\n    return unregister\n  }, [assistantRuntime, activeTab, compositeData])\n\n  // Create context value with all shared functions\n  const contextValue = useMemo(\n    () =\u003e ({\n      activeTab,\n      setActiveTab,\n      isProcessing,\n      setIsProcessing,\n      compositeData,\n      addDocumentData,\n      addWebData,\n      addAgentData,\n      generateCompositeInsights,\n      exportCompositeData,\n    }),\n    [activeTab, isProcessing, compositeData]\n  )\n\n  return (\n    \u003cUnifiedPipelineContext.Provider value={contextValue}\u003e\n      {children}\n    \u003c/UnifiedPipelineContext.Provider\u003e\n  )\n}",

Create the &#96;unified&#96; directory in the pipelines folder\n2. Implement the UnifiedPipelineContext provider\n3. Build adapter utilities to map between data formats\n4. Set up basic tab structure with placeholder components\n\n### Phase 2: UI Component Implementation\n\n1. Build adapter components for each pipeline\n2. Implement the unified view component\n3. Create the combined results visualization\n4. Add export functionality\n\n### Phase 3: Business Logic Integration\n\n1. Extract and integrate business logic from existing pipelines\n2. Implement cross-pipeline functions (combination, analysis)\n3. Ensure all original pipeline functionality works through adapters\n\n### Phase 4: AI Assistant Integration\n\n1. Set up context registration with Assistant UI\n2. Add function registration for AI operations\n3. Implement AI-specific commands and suggestions\n\n### Phase 5: Testing and Optimization\n\n1. Test backward compatibility with existing code\n2. Optimize state updates to prevent unnecessary renders\n3. Add error handling and recovery mechanisms\n4.         "contents": "export async function processDocument(\n...\nexport async function processDocument(\n\tsupabase: SupabaseClient\u003cDatabase\u003e,\n\tdocumentId: string,\n) {\n\tconst startTime = Date.now();\n ...\n catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"[Extract] Pipeline error:\", error);\n\n\t\t// Update document status\n\t\tconsole.log(\"[Extract] Updating document status to error...\");\n\t\tawait supabase\n\t\t\t.from(\"doc_processor_documents\")\n\t\t\t.update({\n\t\t\t\tstatus: \"error\",\n\t\t\t\terror: error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"Unknown error\",\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t.eq(\"id\", documentId);\n\n\t\t// Update task status if it exists\n\t\tconst { data: task } = await supabase\n\t\t\t.from(\"doc_processor_processing_tasks\")\n\t\t\t.select(\"id\")\n\t\t\t.eq(\"document_id\", documentId)\n\t\t\t.eq(\"task_type\", \"extract\")\n\t\t\t.single();\n\n\t\tif (task) {\n\t\t\tconsole.log(\"[Extract] Updating task status to error...\");\n\t\t\tawait supabase\n\t\t\t\t.from(\"doc_processor_processing_tasks\")\n\t\t\t\t.update({\n\t\t\t\t\tstatus: \"error\",\n\t\t\t\t\terror: error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"Unknown error\",\n\t\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t\t.eq(\"id\", task.id);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tthrow error;\n\t} finally {\n\t\tconst duration = Date.now() - startTime;\n\t\tconsole.log(&#96;[Extract] Pipeline processed in ${duration}ms&#96;);\n\t}\n}",

        "contents": "function DocumentProcessingAdapter(props: any) {\n  const { documentState, uploadDocument, analyzeDocument } = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  \n  // Map unified context to props expected by original component\n  const adaptedProps = {\n    ...props,\n    documents: documentState.documents,\n    onUpload: uploadDocument,\n    onAnalyze: analyzeDocument\n    // Add other props mappings as needed\n  }\n  \n  // Render UI similar to original component but using unified context\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"document-processing\"\u003e\n      {/* Document UI components using adaptedProps */}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\nfunction WebProcessingAdapter(props: any) {\n  const { webState, processWebUrl } = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  \n  // Map unified context to props expected by original component\n  const adaptedProps = {\n    ...props,\n    url: webState.url,\n    content: webState.content,\n    onProcess: processWebUrl\n    // Add other props mappings as needed\n  }\n  \n  // Render UI similar to original component but using unified context\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"web-processing\"\u003e\n      {/* Web UI components using adaptedProps */}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\nfunction AgentExecutionAdapter(props: any) {\n  const { agentState, executeAgent } = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  \n  // Map unified context to props expected by original component\n  const adaptedProps = {\n    ...props,\n    agents: agentState.agents,\n    onExecute: executeAgent\n    // Add other props mappings as needed\n  }\n  \n  // Render UI similar to original component but using unified context\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"agent-execution\"\u003e\n      {/* Agent UI components using adaptedProps */}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\n// Unified view that combines elements from all pipelines\n",

Main UI Component (AIPipeline)\n\n- UnifiedPipelineProvider wraps UnifiedPipelineInterfaceContent\n",

        "contents": "# Unified Pipeline Interface Implementation Plan\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document outlines the implementation strategy for creating a unified user interface that integrates all existing processing pipelines (agent-execution, document-processing, and web-processing) while maintaining backward compatibility with the existing separate implementations.\n\n## Architecture Goals\n\n1. **Unified Experience**: Create a single, cohesive UI for all AI pipeline operations\n2. **Shared Context**: Leverage a common context for state and business logic\n3. **Backward Compatibility**: Maintain existing pipeline files and interfaces\n4. **Performance Optimization**: Minimize redundant renders and API calls\n5. **Extensible Design**: Allow for easy addition of future pipelines\n\n## Implementation Components\n\n### 1.         "contents": "\n\n// Constants for concurrent processing\nconst CONCURRENT_TASKS = 2; // Number of concurrent tasks (analysis and entity storage)\n\nexport async function analyzeDocument(\n\tsupabase: SupabaseClient\u003cRecord\u003cstring, unknown\u003e\u003e,\n\tdocumentId: string,\n) {\n\ttry {\n\t\tconsole.log(&#96;[Analysis] Starting analysis for document ${documentId}&#96;);\n\n\t\t// Get document\n\t\tconst { data: document, error: docError } = await supabase\n\t\t\t.from(\"doc_processor_documents\")\n\t\t\t.select(\"*\")\n\t\t\t.eq(\"id\", documentId)\n\t\t\t.single();\n\n\t\tif (docError || !document) {\n\t\t\tconsole.error(\"[Analysis] Document fetch error:\", docError);\n\t\t\tthrow docError || new Error(\"Document not found\");\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconsole.log(&#96;[Analysis] Retrieved document: ${document.title}&#96;);\n\n\t\tif (!document.extracted_text) {\n\t\t\tconsole.error(\"[Analysis] No extracted text found for document\");\n\t\t\tthrow new Error(\"Document has no extracted text\");\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t&#96;[Analysis] Found extracted text of length: ${document.extracted_text.length}&#96;,\n\t\t);\n\n\t\t// Create analysis task\n\t\tconst { data: task, error: taskError } = await supabase\n\t\t\t.from(\"doc_processor_processing_tasks\")\n\t\t\t.insert({\n\t\t\t\tdocument_id: documentId,\n\t\t\t\ttask_type: \"analyze\",\n\t\t\t\tstatus: \"processing\",\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t.select()\n\t\t\t.single();\n\n\t\tif (taskError) {\n\t\t\tconsole.error(\"[Analysis] Task creation error:\", taskError);\n\t\t\tthrow taskError;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconsole.log(&#96;[Analysis] Created analysis task: ${task.id}&#96;);",

        "originalContents": "'use client'\n\n// Unified AI Pipeline Interface Implementation\n// Directly integrates existing pipeline components with a composite knowledge layer\n\nimport React, {createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, type ReactNode, useMemo} from 'react'\nimport {useAssistantRuntime} from '@assistant-ui/react'\n\n// Import actual pipeline components\nimport {DocumentProcessingPipeline} from '../document-processing-pipeline/DocumentProcessingPipeline'\nimport WebProcessingPipeline from '../web-processing-pipeline/WebProcessingPipeline'\nimport {AgentExecutionPipeline} from '../agent-execution-pipeline/AgentExecutionPipeline'\n\n// Types for shared state\ninterface DocumentData {\n  id: string\n  title: string\n  content: string\n  analysis?: Record\u003cstring, unknown\u003e\n}",

        "contents": "function DocumentProcessingAdapter(props: any) {\n  const { documentState, uploadDocument, analyzeDocument } = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  \n  // Map unified context to props expected by original component\n  const adaptedProps = {\n    ...props,\n    documents: documentState.documents,\n    onUpload: uploadDocument,\n    onAnalyze: analyzeDocument\n    // Add other props mappings as needed\n  }\n  \n  // Render UI similar to original component but using unified context\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"document-processing\"\u003e\n      {/* Document UI components using adaptedProps */}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\nfunction WebProcessingAdapter(props: any) {\n  const { webState, processWebUrl } = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  \n  // Map unified context to props expected by original component\n  const adaptedProps = {\n    ...props,\n    url: webState.url,\n    content: webState.content,\n    onProcess: processWebUrl\n    // Add other props mappings as needed\n  }\n  \n  // Render UI similar to original component but using unified context\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"web-processing\"\u003e\n      {/* Web UI components using adaptedProps */}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\nfunction AgentExecutionAdapter(props: any) {\n  const { agentState, executeAgent } = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  \n  // Map unified context to props expected by original component\n  const adaptedProps = {\n    ...props,\n    agents: agentState.agents,\n    onExecute: executeAgent\n    // Add other props mappings as needed\n  }\n  \n  // Render UI similar to original component but using unified context\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"agent-execution\"\u003e\n      {/* Agent UI components using adaptedProps */}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\n// Unified view that combines elements from all pipelines\n",

        "originalContents": "interface UnifiedPipelineContextType {\n  // Shared state\n  activeTab: 'document' | 'web' | 'agent' | 'unified'\n  setActiveTab: (tab: 'document' | 'web' | 'agent' | 'unified') =\u003e void\n  isProcessing: boolean\n  \n  // Document processing state \u0026 functions\n  documentState: DocumentProcessingState\n  uploadDocument: (file: File) =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e\n  analyzeDocument: (documentId: string) =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e\n  \n  // Web processing state \u0026 functions\n  webState: WebProcessingState\n  processWebUrl: (url: string) =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e\n  summarizeWebContent: (content: string) =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e\n  \n  // Agent execution state \u0026 functions\n  agentState: AgentExecutionState\n  executeAgent: (prompt: string, context?: any) =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e\n  \n  // Cross-pipeline functions\n  combineResults: () =\u003e any\n  exportResults: (format: string) =\u003e void\n  \n  // AI Assistant context\n  addToAIContext: (data: any) =\u003e void\n}\n\n// Create the context\nconst UnifiedPipelineContext = createContext\u003cUnifiedPipelineContextType | null\u003e(null)\n\n// Provider component\n",

        "contents": "'use client'\n\nimport type React from 'react'\nimport {useState, useRef} from 'react'\nimport {useUnifiedPipeline} from '../unified/AIPipeline'\n\nexport function VideoProcessingPipeline() {\n  const {addVideoData, setIsProcessing, isProcessing} = useUnifiedPipeline()\n  const [videoFile, setVideoFile] = useState\u003cFile | null\u003e(null)\n  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('')\n  const [analysis, setAnalysis] = useState\u003cany\u003e(null)\n  const [currentFrame, setCurrentFrame] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n  const [processingStage, setProcessingStage] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('')\n  const videoRef = useRef\u003cHTMLVideoElement\u003e(null)\n\n  const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent\u003cHTMLInputElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    const file = e.target.files?.[0]\n    if (file) {\n      setVideoFile(file)\n      // Create URL for video preview\n      const url = URL.createObjectURL(file)\n      setVideoUrl(url)\n      // Reset states\n      setAnalysis(null)\n      setCurrentFrame(null)\n    }\n  }\n\n  const captureFrame = () =\u003e {\n    if (videoRef.current) {\n      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')\n      canvas.width = videoRef.current.videoWidth\n      canvas.height = videoRef.current.videoHeight\n      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')\n      if (ctx) {\n        ctx.drawImage(videoRef.current, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)\n        const frameUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg')\n        setCurrentFrame(frameUrl)\n        return frameUrl\n      }\n    }\n    return null\n  }",

        "contents": "# AIPipeline Implementation Pseudocode\n\n## 1. Context Provider (UnifiedPipelineContext)\n\n- Define types for unified state: DocumentProcessingState, WebProcessingState, AgentExecutionState\n- Create UnifiedPipelineContext with:\n  - activeTab: 'document' | 'web' | 'agent' | 'unified'\n  - setActiveTab(tab)\n  - isProcessing\n  - documentState, uploadDocument(file), analyzeDocument(documentId)\n  - webState, processWebUrl(url), summarizeWebContent(content)\n  - agentState, executeAgent(prompt, context?)\n  - combineResults(), exportResults(format)\n  - addToAIContext(data)\n- Implement UnifiedPipelineProvider:\n  - useState for all state\n  - useAssistantRuntime for AI context\n  - Implement all functions, calling legacy pipeline logic\n  - Register model context with assistantRuntime\n  - Provide context value\n- Export useUnifiedPipeline hook\n\n## 2. Adapter Utilities\n\n- mapDocumentStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapWebStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapAgentStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapDocumentStateToUnified(originalState)\n- mapWebStateToUnified(originalState)\n- mapAgentStateToUnified(originalState)\n\n## 3. Business Logic Integration\n\n- Import and re-export helpers from legacy pipelines:\n  - analyzeDocument, vectorizeDocument\n  - scrapeAndSummarize\n  - executeAgentWorkflow\n- Implement combinePipelineResults(documentResults, webResults, agentResults)\n- Implement createCrossContextualSummary(documentResults, webResults, agentResults)\n\n## 4. Adapter Components\n\n- DocumentProcessingAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy DocumentProcessingPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n- WebProcessingAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy WebProcessingPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n- AgentExecutionAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy AgentExecutionPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n\n## 5. Unified View\n\n- useUnifiedPipeline\n- Render quick input sections for each pipeline\n- Render combined results section\n- Render AI Assistant integration section\n\n## 6. Main UI Component (AIPipeline)\n\n- UnifiedPipelineProvider wraps UnifiedPipelineInterfaceContent\n",

        "contents": "# Unified Pipeline Interface Implementation Plan\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document outlines the implementation strategy for creating a unified user interface that integrates all existing processing pipelines (agent-execution, document-processing, and web-processing) while maintaining backward compatibility with the existing separate implementations.\n\n## Architecture Goals\n\n1. **Unified Experience**: Create a single, cohesive UI for all AI pipeline operations\n2. **Shared Context**: Leverage a common context for state and business logic\n3. **Backward Compatibility**: Maintain existing pipeline files and interfaces\n4. **Performance Optimization**: Minimize redundant renders and API calls\n5. **Extensible Design**: Allow for easy addition of future pipelines\n\n## Implementation Components\n\n### 1. Shared Context Provider\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// src/features/ai/pipelines/unified/UnifiedPipelineContext.tsx\n\nimport { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, ReactNode } from 'react'\nimport { useAssistantRuntime } from '@assistant-ui/react'\nimport { \n  // Import utilities, types and logic from existing pipelines\n  type DocumentProcessingState,\n  type WebProcessingState,\n  type AgentExecutionState\n} from '../types'\n\n",
